pages.title: Frogie - Cross the road
pages.creator: Vagstech
pages.description: Time a frog's hops through busy lanes in Frogie - Cross the road. Move left or right to find a safe opening, then jump ahead before it closes. Keep avoiding the obstacles as the run becomes more intense and try to beat your previous distance.

pages.title: Toco Teens Halloween Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress a group of teens for a spooky celebration in Toco Teens Halloween Party. Choose from eerie outfits, accessories and bold makeup, then bring the details together for each character. Try different combinations to give everyone a distinct Halloween look.

pages.title: Cube to Hole Puzzle
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Move colored blocks into their matching holes in Cube to Hole Puzzle. The board has little spare room, so decide which cube needs to go first to keep the other routes usable. Use the few available slots to rearrange the pieces without blocking the next move.

pages.title: Word of Fortune
pages.creator: Lady Puzzle Pro
pages.description: Solve a clue to guess a five-letter answer in Word of Fortune. You can spin the letter wheel three times for hints, but you have only two guesses at the word. Return for a new daily puzzle or work through the themed levels.

pages.title: DIY Phone Case Shop
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Create customized cases for customers in DIY Phone Case Shop. Pick designs, patterns and decorations that fit each request, then improve the shop with items that attract more visitors. Keep fulfilling orders as you develop the case-design business.

pages.title: Grandma with machine-gun: Apocalypsis
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Fight through zombie-filled roads in Grandma with machine-gun: Apocalypsis. Enemies pursue on cars and motorcycles with weapons of their own, so use Granny's arsenal to hold them back. Switch between tools such as machine guns and a bazooka as the chase develops.

pages.title: Woop Crawl Up
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Crawl, jump and dash higher in Woop Crawl Up. Read the tower's platforms before each move and watch for traps that interrupt the climb. Use your movement options to stay on the route as the endless obstacle course continues above.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Remastered
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Fire at clusters of identical bubbles in Bubble Shooter Remastered. Bring at least three of the same color together to burst them, and use the gaps they leave to reach more of the board. Plan the next shot around the color in your launcher.

pages.title: Spooky Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Connect matching Halloween tiles in Spooky Link along a route with at most two turns. Remove pairs that open useful channels through the board, then check which new tiles can reach one another. Clear every pair to move on.

pages.title: Slope Spooky
pages.creator: GM - Good Media
pages.description: Steer a rolling ball down eerie tracks in Slope Spooky. Use the arrow keys or A and D to avoid obstacles and keep the ball from dropping off the edges. Watch the track ahead as each slope sends you toward the next hazard.

pages.title: Count and Bounce
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Rotate platforms to keep a bouncing ball on course in Count and Bounce. Some tiles offer arithmetic choices, so pick the operation that best suits your current number of balls. Keep the route connected while the ball continues forward on its own.

pages.title: Car Service Tycoon
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Run a workshop in Car Service Tycoon. Repair engines, brakes and electrical faults to get the cars ready to drive, then try cosmetic changes such as new paintwork. Work through the vehicles as you develop the services offered by your garage.

pages.title: Super Sniper Missions
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Take timed assignments in Super Sniper Missions. Identify the criminals, line up a clear shot and keep the hostages safe as you work through different city locations. Unlock rifles such as the M74 and 98K to try on later missions.

pages.title: Stunt Rider
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through obstacle-filled stages in Stunt Rider. Control its balance over jumps and slopes so you reach the finish without flipping. Open more levels and spend your earnings on additional bikes as you improve your runs.

pages.title: Garage Master - Nuts and Bolts
pages.creator: Artem Lanin
pages.description: Group nuts by color on their bolts in Garage Master - Nuts and Bolts. Move the mixed pieces in an order that leaves space to reach the ones underneath. Keep rearranging until each color is gathered onto the appropriate bolt.

pages.title: Cut Grass
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Slide a circular blade around the patches of ground in Cut Grass. Plan a route that passes over every tuft and leaves no grass standing. There is no score or countdown to chase, so you can take time working out the full path.

pages.title: Draw The Weapon
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sketch a weapon within an ink limit in Draw The Weapon, then take it into a fight. Use the creation to knock enemies off the cliff and complete the battle. Try different weapon designs and unlockable skins as you continue.

pages.title: Ellie Thanksgiving Day
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help Ellie finish preparing dinner in Ellie Thanksgiving Day. Her friends are on their way, so work through the last tasks needed for the meal and celebration. Bring the remaining details together before the guests arrive.

pages.title: Polar Bear Merge
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Throw numbered ice into matching pieces in Polar Bear Merge to create larger values. Drag to aim and choose a landing that gives you another merge. More ice appears over time, and the game ends when the pile reaches the bottom.

pages.title: Parmesan Partisan Deluxe
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Defend a cheese-loving community in Parmesan Partisan Deluxe. Move around the battlefield with your shotgun and stop the invading Mice People before they overwhelm the defenders. Keep watching the approaches as more rodents join the attack.

pages.title: Wedding Coloring Dress Up Game
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Design the couple's outfits in Wedding Coloring Dress Up Game, then choose their colors. Try clothing on both the bride and groom before painting the details to suit your wedding theme. Combine the dress-up choices with coloring to finish the pair.

pages.title: Noob VS. Spider Train
pages.creator: OleAle
pages.description: Escape Charles across block-built landscapes in Noob VS. Spider Train. Watch both the obstacles ahead and the fireballs launched by the train while keeping your runner moving. Collect diamonds to unlock additional characters and locations for the chase.

pages.title: Gun Head Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Steer a moving gun through upgrade gates in Gun Head Run. Choose positive-number gates to increase its shooting power and fire at the platforms to collect money and weapons. Build up enough firepower to handle the end of each run.

pages.title: Find The Difference Emoji Puzzle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Search a crowded set of faces in Find The Difference Emoji Puzzle. Compare expressions carefully to pick out the ones that differ from their neighbors. Find all the odd emojis before the timer ends to open the next level.

pages.title: Car Parking City Duel
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Try races, parking tasks, overtaking challenges and exploding-car contests in Car Parking City Duel. Choose a single-player event or share most modes with a friend using the two-player controls. Learn how the car handles before tackling the tighter maneuvers.

pages.title: Ludibubbles
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Aim a cannon into colored bubbles in Ludibubbles. Place the current shot where it can join matching bubbles and clear part of the cluster. Read the arrangement after each burst to find a useful position for the next color.

pages.title: Rotating Cube
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Guide the turning block in Rotating Cube and react to the colored platform ahead. Use the mouse to time your moves and keep the cube in play. Try to raise your score before the remaining lives run out.

pages.title: One line only dot to dot
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Connect every dot with a continuous stroke in One line only dot to dot. Plan your route through the shape before starting so you can reach all the points without lifting the mouse or finger. Work from simple drawings toward more involved patterns.

pages.title: Noob Vs Pro 3
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Help Noob and Noobella after a stick tsunami in Noob Vs Pro 3. Work through the platforming challenges, earn money and craft weapons or buy upgrades. Follow the comic scenes involving Pro, Hacker and God as the escape continues.

pages.title: Footix.io
pages.creator: LapaMauve
pages.description: Work with teammates to win football matches in Footix.io. Move with WASD, use the mouse to run and kick, and slide with the space bar to challenge for possession. Try the tutorial to learn the controls before entering a match.

pages.title: Hamster Island
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build a settlement for hamsters in Hamster Island. Add farms, cafes and restaurants to give the residents places to live and visit. Invite more hamsters as the village grows and look out for characters dressed as other animals.

pages.title: Squid Hook Game
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Throw a hooked rope at players across the field in Squid Hook Game. Catch an opponent and pull them toward your side, then use the points earned to buy more characters. Choose among workers, players and dolls as the available roster grows.

pages.title: Crazy BFF Party
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style Harlequin and Jen for an extravagant celebration in Crazy BFF Party. Try bright makeup, unusual hairstyles and informal clothes with details such as fishnets or tattoos. Give each friend a look that fits her bold approach to the evening.

pages.title: 2 Player Imposter Soccer
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Move a big-headed footballer into position in 2 Player Imposter Soccer. Jump to meet the ball and try to put it past your rival while protecting your own net. Play a head-to-head match against a friend with the two-player controls.

pages.title: Drunken Spin Punch
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Swing your fists while keeping your balance in Drunken Spin Punch. Watch your energy so you can keep attacking when an opening appears. Fight the computer or a friend, with the first player to score five winning the match.

pages.title: Super Billy Boy
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Rescue Billy's friend from an alien robot in Super Billy Boy. Run and jump through an unfamiliar planet, avoiding traps and fighting enemies along the route. Help the group make it back from the expedition as you work through the platforming stages.

pages.title: Puzzle Balls
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Guide a group of balls through physics puzzles in Puzzle Balls. Look at the layout before setting them moving and work out how to bring them through the obstacles. Each handmade arrangement asks you to use the available space in a different way.

pages.title: Celebrity Cute Couple
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Choose outfits for two stars in Celebrity Cute Couple. Follow the pair to settings such as a party, school or dance studio and get them ready for each occasion. Coordinate their makeup and clothes or give the two characters contrasting looks.

pages.title: Dr Panda School
pages.creator: Dr. Panda LTD
pages.description: Explore a school with Dr. Panda and his friends in Dr Panda School. Visit themed classrooms, hallways, the kitchen and the canteen, then interact with the characters and objects you find. Make up your own scenes as you move around the building.

pages.title: Arrow's Adventure
pages.creator: Go Game Pte Ltd
pages.description: Enter the dungeon with a bow in Arrow's Adventure. Keep moving to avoid attacks, then stop when you want the hero to fire. Clear each wave to open a treasure chest, choose a power-up and spend coins on upgrades before going deeper.

pages.title: Popping Balloon
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Pop balloons before they float away in Popping Balloon. Escaped balloons reduce your remaining time, but the ones marked with an X also carry a penalty if you hit them. Pick targets carefully while trying to fit more successful pops into the round.

pages.title: Zombie Killer
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Clear an infected city in Zombie Killer by choosing a hero and fighting through missions. Use weapons and explosives to deal with the undead, then spend coins on better equipment or additional heroes. Check each mission's objective before you begin.

pages.title: Bicycle Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Assemble ten cycling pictures in Bicycle Jigsaw. Earn money from completed boards and save enough to buy the next image. Choose a difficulty for each puzzle, with harder layouts paying more when you fit all the pieces together.

pages.title: Draw Missing Part Puzzle
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Sketch the absent object or detail in Draw Missing Part Puzzle. Inspect the picture to work out what it needs, then draw the missing piece where it belongs. Use a hint when the intended solution is hard to see.

pages.title: Hot Rod Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put together cartoon custom cars in Hot Rod Jigsaw. Pick a vehicle picture and select easy, medium or hard difficulty before arranging its pieces. Follow body panels, wheels and background details to reconstruct the whole image.

pages.title: Soccer Online
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Plan attacks and defend your side in Soccer Online. Use the mouse or touch controls to direct the action against another player, trying to make the better decisions before time runs out. Play with friends and work on turning possession into goals.

pages.title: Magic Stone Jewels Match 3
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Match rows or columns of three identical jewels in Magic Stone Jewels Match 3. Direct the matches over dirty cells to clean the board, and work around stones that are locked in place. Certain match shapes create power-ups to help with the remaining squares.

pages.title: Pizza Clicker Tycoon
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Click the pizza to earn more in Pizza Clicker Tycoon. Spend your earnings on toppings and upgrades, then keep improving the operation as new purchases become available. Develop the pizza from a simple starting point into the center of your growing business.

pages.title: Hot Air Solitaire
pages.creator: Zigiz
pages.description: Join Sir Richard Dandy aboard his balloon in Hot Air Solitaire. Play through the card layouts while the explorer travels above London, finding sequences that let you remove more cards. Follow the journey as you work through each deal.

pages.title: Treating Stuck Fish Bone
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Bella during a simulated clinic visit in Treating Stuck Fish Bone. A bone from her seafood dinner is stuck in her throat, so follow the game's prompts to find and remove it. Work through the treatment steps to finish the visit.

pages.title: Offroad Monster Truck Forest Championship
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Race a monster truck through forest terrain in Offroad Monster Truck Forest Championship. Steer with WASD and use the brake to control your approach to bends. Get around computer-controlled competitors and try to reach the destination first.

pages.title: Racing Cars
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Pick a sports car and head onto one of four circuits in Racing Cars. Choose from five modes, use nitro when you want more speed and brake for tighter bends. Learn each track as you try different cars and events.

pages.title: Epic Flip
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: React to a moving cube's path in Epic Flip. Time your clicks to keep it moving through the changing world and anticipate what the next section requires. Keep following the route as the scenery and obstacles approach.

pages.title: Sweet Match 3
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Swap sweets into matching groups in Sweet Match 3. Look for a row or column of at least three candies to clear them and open space for new pieces. Use the changing layout to keep finding matches and collect more sweets.

pages.title: Globe Driver
pages.creator: Thumb Game Studio
pages.description: Drive around a small world in Globe Driver while watching for falling objects. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move away from hazards and collect the red dots you encounter. Keep the vehicle safe for as long as you can.

pages.title: Racing Motorbike Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild motorcycle photographs in Racing Motorbike Slide. Pick one of three images, choose a puzzle mode and slide the tiles through the open space. Use the bike's outline and the background to work out the correct arrangement.

pages.title: Love Animals
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Draw lines that bring animal pairs together in Love Animals. Consider how each line will affect their movement before you release it into the physics scene. Try a different shape when the pair stop short of touching one another.

pages.title: Garbage Truck Simulator : Recycling Driving Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Collect city rubbish in Garbage Truck Simulator : Recycling Driving Game. Drive the truck along its collection route and bring the load to the recycling company. Keep handling deliveries as you build up the business from its first jobs.

pages.title: Porsche Taycan Turbo S Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble six pictures of an electric sports car in Porsche Taycan Turbo S Puzzle. Choose from four sizes, beginning at sixteen pieces and extending to one hundred. Match the pieces using the vehicle's bodywork and the scene around it.

pages.title: Zombie Hunter
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight across different maps in Zombie Hunter. Choose from the available firearms, keep an eye on approaching zombies and use medkits when you need to recover. Move with WASD and aim with the mouse as you clear the area.

pages.title: 17th Shape
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Slide identical figures together in 17th Shape to create the next shape in the sequence. Think about how a move shifts the rest of the board and leave room for more pairs. Use the limited shuffle or regroup options when you need another opening.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Swimming Time
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Pack swimming clothes and supplies with Baby Hazel in Baby Hazel Swimming Time. Check that she has what she needs, then join her for the lesson Uncle James promised. Help her through the preparations and the activities at the pool.

pages.title: Taco Blaster
pages.creator: IDLA Games
pages.description: Shoot back at hostile food in Taco Blaster. Move with the arrow keys and fire with the space bar as the screen scrolls onward. Watch for threats entering your path and keep the taco clear while you fire at the next group.

pages.title: Flying Jelly
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Click the colorful jellies in Flying Jelly before they pass out of reach. Leave the gray ones alone and choose targets quickly as more appear. Keep watching the color of each jelly so a fast reaction does not turn into the wrong hit.

pages.title: Sleepy Princess Twins Birth
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help the princess prepare for the hospital in Sleepy Princess Twins Birth. Call the ambulance, bring her water and oxygen, and invite the prince to help her relax while she waits. Continue the story at the hospital when the twins arrive.

pages.title: Draw One Line
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Trace a continuous route through the dots in Draw One Line. Plan the connections before starting so you can finish the figure without lifting your finger or mouse. Try more than one hundred layouts as the line patterns become harder to complete.

pages.title: EG Goal Keeper
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Guard the net in EG Goal Keeper and stop incoming balls from scoring. React to the direction of each shot as the game speeds up. Keep your misses below the three-ball limit and try to extend the round with another save.

pages.title: EG Punch Box
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Punch away stacked crates in EG Punch Box. Change sides before a sharp piece of wood reaches the boxer, and keep breaking boxes to add time. Work quickly enough to extend the run without moving into a dangerous branch.

pages.title: Tape It Up Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Move between conveyor lanes and seal packages in Tape It Up Online. Watch the gaps between boxes so you can stay on the line while wrapping as many as possible. Collect coins to unlock different tapes and pick up power-ups during a run.

pages.title: Fix My Phone
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Repair a princess's broken handset in Fix My Phone. Follow the steps to work on the damaged device and restore its appearance. Use the available tools as prompted until the phone is ready to return to its owner.

pages.title: Become An Animal Dentist
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Work at a veterinary dental clinic in Become An Animal Dentist. Use the instruments to clean and care for the animals' teeth, following each patient's prompts. Complete one treatment at a time as different pets arrive for help.

pages.title: Soccer.io
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Protect your goal in Soccer.io while knocking balls into rivals' nets. Scoring lets you grow, but conceding four times puts you out. Move quickly between defense and attack and try to become the last player left in the arena.

pages.title: Ritual Duel
pages.creator: Enclave Games
pages.description: Compete against a witch in Ritual Duel as a shaman performing a ritual. Watch the objects you need to collect and respond to their changing positions. Keep the ritual going while trying to outdo the opponent across from you.

pages.title: Mow it! Lawn puzzle
pages.creator: kpded
pages.description: Cut every patch of grass in Mow it! Lawn puzzle without crossing the mower's electrical cable. Plan a route through the lawn before it leaves the cable in your way. Later puzzles require you to coordinate two mowers at once.

pages.title: Princess Shoe Design
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a new pair of shoes for Mulan in Princess Shoe Design. Choose the details of the footwear to help her surprise her grandmother with a more traditional look. Bring the parts together to finish a pair suited to the gift.

pages.title: Kids Toys Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Search toy-filled pictures for five stars in Kids Toys Hidden Stars. Look around the edges of the toys and other small details before selecting each one. There is no countdown, so you can inspect every scene at your own pace.

pages.title: Crazy animals dentist
pages.creator: dreamgamestudio@gmail.com
pages.description: Treat the teeth of zoo animals in Crazy animals dentist. Clean stains, remove bacteria and replace damaged teeth as each patient needs. After the treatment, use colors and patterns to give the animal's new smile a playful finish.

pages.title: Jigsaw Deluxe
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Pick a picture and complete it quickly in Jigsaw Deluxe. Choose one of six images and a 16-, 36-, 64- or 100-piece layout. Drag the pieces into place and use the visible details to reconstruct the scene.

pages.title: Pilot Heroes
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Pilot an aircraft through changing assignments in Pilot Heroes. Put out fires in one mission and chase jets in another, adapting how you fly to each objective. Keep control as the next task arrives and the flight adventure continues.

pages.title: Color Hexagon
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rotate the center in Color Hexagon to receive incoming colored blocks. Build matching groups to remove pieces before the stacks extend past the outer gray boundary. Watch which side the next block approaches and turn early enough to place it usefully.

pages.title: Bus Rally
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Drive a bus over rolling hills in Bus Rally. Control its momentum as you climb and descend so the long vehicle can get through the course. Watch the shape of the next slope before committing to a faster approach.

pages.title: Princess Pet Studio
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Dress a royal animal companion in Princess Pet Studio. Pick a pet and choose clothes and decorations that suit its princess. Mix the available pieces to give the animal a recognizable style of its own.

pages.title: Steam Trucker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Carry a load through hilly tracks in Steam Trucker. Keep the cargo in the back while steering over rises and descents. Balance speed with control so you can reach the destination without losing what you were sent to transport.

pages.title: Little Princess Beauty Tips
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Give a young royal a salon visit in Little Princess Beauty Tips. Start by cleaning her face and following the treatment steps, then style her hair. Finish the makeover with makeup and an outfit that works with the new look.

pages.title: Angelina And Brad Romantic Date
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Help Angelina prepare for an evening with Brad in Angelina And Brad Romantic Date. Work through the salon's makeover choices and choose clothes for the occasion. Bring the makeup and outfit together before the couple's date.
